instructions: This repository is divided into 48 area branches (content/*, feature/*, backend/*, test/*, ci/*, chore/tooling, docs/agents-guides) — see BRANCHES.md at the repo root for the full area-to-branch map, reserved worktree branches, and scoped check commands. When reviewing a PR: (1) verify the change stays inside its branch's area as defined in BRANCHES.md and flag cross-area edits as scope creep unless the PR description says otherwise; (2) main is the only deployable branch — changes destined for main must pass `npm run check:all`, and scoped `npm run check` must pass for area branches; (3) reserved branches agents/*, claude/*, worktree/* hold other sessions' uncommitted work — flag any attempt to delete or rewrite them; (4) content/*.json must remain valid JSON (unescaped LaTeX backslashes and stray commas are the known corruption patterns); (5) never commit secrets (vcp_/sbp_/AIza/sk-/KEY=/TOKEN= patterns).

rules.rule: Keep each change inside the area of its branch as mapped in BRANCHES.md; cross-area edits need explicit justification in the PR description
main is the only deployable branch; never force-push; never delete merged-confirmation-missing branches
content/**/*.json must parse as valid JSON — reject unescaped LaTeX backslashes and stray standalone commas/braces
Never commit secrets or API keys; flag any vcp_/sbp_/AIza/sk-/KEY=/TOKEN= pattern
